parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, a lightweight and flexible plastic material.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate, similar to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability, resting on the right ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to fold inward or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame front and lenses, made of polycarbonate for durability and clarity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the primary optical function of vision correction or sun protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central structural component connecting both legs.
